notes: Objectives are printed in one 'Objectifs' cell per theme; they are kept at theme level (topic null), not split between units. Pages 44-52 (p43 is the section cover 'Sciences expérimentales'). 5 themes, 14 numbered units + theme III which has no numbered unit (topic null). Each theme is a 4-column table (Thème | Objectifs | Contenu | Activités envisageables); the 'Activités envisageables' column (including its NB remarks) is excluded. domain = the Thème (week counts dropped), topic = the numbered unit in the Contenu column. In the tables the Objectifs column is one undivided cell per theme page (the dashed row separators run only across Contenu/Activités), so each objective was assigned to the unit it is printed beside on the page image, checked against its wording. Contents are the Contenu lines as printed (sub-headings like 'Les cellules sexuelles :' kept as their own item, bullets/dashes stripped). Objectives are short action-verb statements (Expliquer / Décrire / Reconnaître / Résoudre / Argumenter / Construire / Définir / Distinguer / Adopter / Etre conscient), 1-4 per unit. Placement calls: p49 'Expliquer la naissance, la propagation et la transmission du message nerveux.' is printed beside unit 1 (above the dashed separator) but its wording matches unit 2 (Le message nerveux), so it was put in unit 2; p50 'Adopter un comportement préventif de la santé du système nerveux' is printed just above the unit-5 separator but belongs to 5- Hygiène du système nerveux by wording. Units 4 (pression artérielle) and V-2 (RIMH/RIMC) have no Contenu items beyond their title. p52 'Phase d’amplification et de différenciation :' ends with a colon and no following item, as printed. 'Etre' kept without accent as printed.
